scheme_name: Scholarship To Scheduled Castes Students Studying In Government ITI’s
other_conditions: Must be a resident of Haryana
Must belong to the Scheduled Castes of Haryana
Cannot receive benefits from any other State or Central scheme
Must not be a failed student
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹200 per month and reimbursement of ₹15 per month tuition fee per academic year for eligible SC students in government ITIs.
